_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Government Furnished Property Inventory and Forecasting Report
summary: The Government Property Inventory and Forecasting Report provides Government Property inventory data along with spares, repair parts, and consumables usage and provides a forecast for such items based on usage and other logistics forecasting tools and methods.
use_relationship:
The Government Property Inventory and Forecasting Report provides Government Property inventory data along with spares, repair parts, and consumables usage and provides a forecast for such items based on usage and other logistics forecasting tools and methods.
a) This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
b) This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-81947A.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Government format will be provided in either a Government Furnished Property (GFP) excel workbook for large amounts of GFP or a GFP Attachment in a fillable Adobe pdf. form. Both the excel workbook and the .pdf fillable form shows there is an agreement between the Contractor and the Government of what is provided under the contract as GFP (tangible assets only). The excel GFP Attachment has four sections: Contract Information, Serially Managed Items, Non-Serially Managed Items, and items that the Contractor can requisition which will be paid for by the Government.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Government Furnished Property Inventory and Forecasting Report shall include the following four (4) elements:

children.title: Contract Information Tab
children.content:
Attachment Number
Attachment File
Attachment Date
Contracting Officer Information
Contract or Solicitation Information
Custodial Procurement Instrument Identification

children.title: Serially Managed Items
children.content:
are provided to the Contractor by DoD and require all events identified in DFARS 252.211-7007 to be reported by the Contractor. The Serially Managed Items tab shall include the following data items:
Line Number*
Item Name*
Item Description*
National Stock Number**
Manufacturer's CAGE Code***
Part Number***
Model Number**
Serial Number
Unique Item Identifier (UII)
Quantity*
Unit of Measure*
Unit Acquisition Costs
Use as Is*
Delivery Date
Duration
Time Unit*
Delivery Event*
Notes

children.title: Non-serially Managed Items
children.content:
are provided to the Contractor by DoD and require only the event of GFP receipt to be reported to iRAPT. The Non-Serial Managed Items tab shall include the following data items:
Line Number*
Item Name*
Item Description*
National Stock Number**
Manufacturer's CAGE Code***
Part Number***
Model Number**
Quantity*
Unit of Measure*
Unit Acquisition Costs
Use as Is*
Delivery Date
Duration
Time Unit*
Delivery Event*
Notes

children.title: Items that are authorized to be requisitioned by the Contractor
children.content:
and paid for by DoD are listed on the Requisitioned Items section. Note that items for which the Contractor has authorization to requisition which are paid for by the Contractor are not identified on the GFP Attachment.
Line Number*
Item Name*
Item Description*
National Stock Number**
Manufacturer's CAGE Code***
Part Number***
Quantity*
Unit of Measure*
Unit Acquisition Costs
Use as Is*
*Denotes a required field.
** A minimum of one of these fields is required for each item record
***If either the Manufacturer's CAGE code or Part Number is entered, the other is required.
If any one of the duration, time unit, or delivery event is populated, all three must be populated.
Note: Instructions for filling out the GFP Attachment can be found at: http://dodprocurementtoolbox.com/site-pages/gfp-attachments

preparation_instructions.title: Forecast Quantity
preparation_instructions.content:
Item Number
Part Number
Nomenclature
Forecasted Quantity Required (for the next ordering period)
Cost per unit
Total Cost
The Forecast Quantity is not standard for the GFP requirement for contractual purposes but is for Resource Finance Management and budgeting purposes. It for what parts and equipment needs to be on order to be delivered in time so that there is not a backorder or parts and equipment not available when needed.
